card.name: Digits inside DOIs and phone numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits or separators partway through a DOI or JSTOR number in a reference list. Also digits inside phone numbers.

modes.label: DOI and JSTOR digits
modes.description: A digit or slash inside a citation identifier such as a DOI or JSTOR number.

modes.label: Phone number digits
modes.description: A digit inside the middle of a phone number given as contact information.

card.plain: It marks the middle digits of long reference codes and phone numbers, not any medical content.
